# Syndic.us

> AI-powered digital twins of world-class coaches, delivered as a Council of Minds for 24/7 personalized guidance.

Syndic.us lets people consult an AI Council made up of digital twins ("PersonaBots") of real coaches. Each PersonaBot represents a coach's voice, methodology, and expertise. Users can chat 1-on-1 with a single coach or convene a Syndic8 — a multi-coach council that drafts, debates, and synthesizes balanced recommendations.
